text:
Hello coordinators,
The late crew raised something about bedding supplies after dinner, so please make sure the storage shelf is topped off before the next handoff. Keep the routine check simple and steady: confirm clean liners, fresh pads, and any comfort items that need replacing, then note anything unusual in the service log. If a traveler asks about cabin setup or post-arrival care, give the same clear guidance we use every day and keep the language calm and direct.

As a reminder, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for care support from booking through pickup, so please keep an eye on each file and pass along any changes right away. The senior coordinator should be looped in on any service concern that affects the plan, especially when a pet needs extra attention or when a family has special handling notes. If Emil Hernandez or Amara Wong come through with updates, make sure the details are reflected in the desk notes without delay. Thor and other pets should always receive patient handling from trained staff, with steady communication and no shortcuts.

Please also remember to check that handoff papers are complete and that the departure packet matches the current care plan before anything leaves the desk. A clean record helps the team stay aligned, and it makes the pickup process smoother for everyone involved. If you notice supplies running low, flag it early and keep the rest of the team informed in plain terms. Thanks for keeping the workflow organized and for giving each animal the same careful attention across every step.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
